faq_heading: Homes near Seaquam Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Seaquam Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Seaquam Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Seaquam Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Seaquam Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 275 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,265,000, townhomes $760,000, condos $482,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Seaquam Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Seaquam Secondary the median was 29 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 275 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Seaquam Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cougar Canyon Elementary (0.2 km east), Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.7 km west) and Heath Elementary (0.8 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Seaquam Secondary

24 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Seaquam Secondary in a straight line (18 elementary, 6 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Cougar Canyon Elementary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is North Delta Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Burnsview Secondary (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.7 km). Other secondary schools close by: Burnsview Secondary (1.8 km north), Tamanawis Secondary (2.2 km east), Princess Margaret Secondary (2.8 km east), Sands Secondary (2.8 km north-west), Delta Continuing Education (3.0 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Burnsview Secondary, 1.8 km north of Seaquam Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Seaquam Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Seaquam Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Seaquam Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of Seaquam Secondary was $1,265,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Burnsview Secondary, the nearest other secondary school, 1.8 km north of Seaquam Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
